decision: Treat all eight review findings plus post-deduplication file decomposition as one compatibility-preserving migration
why: The user requested every improvement, and the join and projection findings share invariants that must be changed in sequence

decision: Use high rigor with per-unit proofs and a committed audit trail
why: The work crosses public behavior, generic APIs, concurrency, ordering, performance, and repository structure

decision: Traced public join plans, materialization, region state, ordering, poison, and specialized routing before designing
why: The two engines have different routing units and bounds, so a direct replacement is not safely inferable from file similarity

decision: Added a repeatable semver, targeted behavior, formatting, and clippy verifier
why: Every later unit needs the same compatibility and behavior checks against the untouched baseline

decision: Captured the two-stage join single-update baseline at 2.6201 microseconds
why: Join consolidation must not trade away the optimization that justified the specialized kernel

decision: Reject zero-capacity channels and evict one oldest value before retrying a full dropping channel
why: A zero-capacity blocking subscription deadlocked during synchronous seeding, and the old full-path retried without freeing capacity

decision: Replace the atomic-plus-UnsafeCell once callback with Mutex<Option<F>> and invoke after releasing the lock
why: The mutex expresses exclusive ownership safely, removes unsafe impls, and remains reentrancy-safe because the callback is taken before execution

decision: Select one private lifecycle host with separate arbitrary-N and specialized two-stage kernels
why: Three candidates converged; the cross-judge selected Candidate A but required retaining current public-plan storage and third-join lowering until separately proven

decision: Fail on erased root/index type mismatch and repeated physical binding before mutating valid compiler state
why: The typed construction makes these states unreachable; continuing with a replacement root or index hid internal corruption

decision: Centralize projection ownership and recover poisoned projection mutexes explicitly
why: Three public projections duplicated subscription lifetime logic and silently stopped updating after poison

decision: Retain compact benchmark decisions and ignore generated captures
why: Raw generated output dominated the tracked tree while no build or test consumed it

decision: Replace coupled optional runtimes and independent activity state with an exhaustive serial/sharded enum
why: Serial plus shards, neither runtime, and active-without-shards were representable and forced repeated branching

decision: Give MapDiff one owner for atomic keys, work sizing, ordered leaf visitation, and flattening
why: Join engines repeated recursive container semantics and could drift on nested batches
evidence: hyphae/src/cell_map.rs; join_region.rs; join_runtime.rs; focused traversal and join tests
